52	55 invaders: 5 rows × 11 cols. Row 0 = **squid** (30 pts), rows 1–2 = **crab** (20), rows 3–4 = **octopus** (10).
53	Logical position of invader (r, c): `x = originX + c·COL_PITCH`, `y = originY − r·ROW_PITCH`, `COL_PITCH = 2.2`, `ROW_PITCH = 1.8`.
54	Wave `w` starts with `originY = FORMATION_TOP_Y − min(w−1, 4)·DROP_Y` (formation starts lower, as in the original, capped).
55	
56	**Tempo.** The 1978 machine moved one alien per frame, so a full formation step took `alive` frames. Model:
57	```
58	interval(alive, wave) = clamp(alive / 60, MIN_STEP_INTERVAL = 0.045, 1.0) / speedMul(wave)
59	speedMul(wave)        = 1 + 0.10·(wave − 1)
60	```
61	55 alive ⇒ 0.92 s per step; last alien ⇒ 0.045 s. The march bass note fires on each step, so the music accelerates organically.
62	
63	**Stepping (fixed 120 Hz step).**
64	```
65	timer += step
66	if timer ≥ interval:
67	    timer -= interval
68	    if pendingDrop:  originY -= DROP_Y (0.9);  dir = −dir;  pendingDrop = false;  emit 'invader:drop'
69	    else:            originX += dir·STEP_X (0.275)
70	                     b = aliveBounds()           // min/max x over living invaders
71	                     if (dir>0 && b.maxX + HALF_INVADER_W ≥ HALF_WIDTH − EDGE_MARGIN) ||
72	                        (dir<0 && b.minX − HALF_INVADER_W ≤ −HALF_WIDTH + EDGE_MARGIN):  pendingDrop = true
73	    frame ^= 1;  hop ripple starts;  emit 'invader:step'
74	    if lowestAliveBottom() ≤ INVASION_Y:  emit 'invader:invaded'
75	```
76	Edge detection uses only living invaders, so a thinned formation sweeps wider — the classic behaviour.
77	In TITLE (attract mode) `demo = true`: reverse without dropping.
78	
79	**Shooting.**
80	```
81	maxShots(wave) = min(3 + floor((wave−1)/2), 5)
82	fireInterval   = rand(0.35, 1.10) · (0.55 + 0.45·alive/55) · max(1 − 0.06·(wave−1), 0.5)
83	on timer ≤ 0 and liveInvaderBullets < maxShots:
84	    col     = chance(0.35) ? aliveColumnNearest(player.x) : randomAliveColumn()
85	    shooter = bottom-most living invader in col
86	    spawn invader bullet at (shooter.x, shooter.y − 0.7), kind ∈ {plunger, rolling, squiggly} (weighted 40/35/25)
87	```
88	Squiggly bullets zig-zag: `x = x0 + 0.25·sin(2π·9·age)`. Rolling bullets spin about Y. Speed `9 + 0.6·(wave−1)` wu/s.
89	
90	**Fly-in.** On WAVE_INTRO each invader's visual starts at `logical + (0, +14)` and eases (easeOutCubic, 0.7 s) after delay `0.06·r + 0.03·c`. Formation logic is frozen until the last invader lands (≈ 1.7 s), then a shockwave ring pulses under the formation.
91	
92	**Hop animation (visual only, per step).** Each column starts its hop `8 ms · c` after the step (ripple). With `t` = normalised hop time:
93	`offsetY = 0.12·sin(πt)`, `scaleY = 1 + 0.18·sin(πt)`, `scaleX = 1 − 0.10·sin(πt)`. Collision always uses logical positions.
94	
95	### 1.3 Player cannon
96	Velocity-based control with snappy, frame-rate-independent acceleration:
97	```
98	target = axis('moveX') · PLAYER_SPEED (13)
99	vx     = approach(vx, target, PLAYER_ACCEL (140) · step)
100	x      = clamp(x + vx·step, −HALF_WIDTH + 1.1, HALF_WIDTH − 1.1)
101	bank   = damp(bank, −vx/PLAYER_SPEED · 0.35 rad, 12, dt)   // visual roll
102	```
103	Firing: one bullet in flight (classic) unless a power-up raises the cap; `FIRE_COOLDOWN = 0.16 s`. Fire is read with `input.takePress(FIRE)` (latched edge) so a press is never lost on frames where zero fixed steps run (144 Hz displays vs 120 Hz sim). Keyboard edges are derived from a per-key keydown counter, so a tap shorter than one frame — or two taps inside one frame — still registers. Holding fire auto-repeats at the cooldown. Invaders hold fire for `GRACE_TIME = 1.6 s` after a respawn.
104	Hit: if `shield` → shield consumed (ring + sound), else life lost → PLAYER_DEATH. Respawn after 1.6 s with 2.5 s invulnerability (blink at 8 Hz, 40 % emissive).
105	
106	### 1.4 Projectiles
107	Pooled (`ObjectPool`): 6 player bullets, 8 invader bullets. Every bullet stores `prevX/prevY` so collisions are **swept segment vs AABB** (slab test) — no tunnelling even at 30 wu/s. Player bullet: speed 30, half-extents (0.08, 0.35). Invader bullet half-extents (0.12, 0.40). Player bullet vs invader bullet ⇒ both cancel (classic) with a spark.
108	
109	### 1.5 Bunkers
110	4 bunkers, each a 12 × 8 cell bitmap (`CELL = 0.32`, classic silhouette with the bottom notch). One `InstancedMesh` (384 cells). Cell HP = 2: first hit scorches (instance colour → dark amber, emissive drops), second removes (matrix scaled to 0, cell dead).
111	Bullet vs bunker: coarse AABB, then walk the bullet's segment through cells (≤ 4 cells at these speeds); first live cell hit → `damage(cell, radius 1)`: centre −2 HP, 4-neighbours −1 HP with p = 0.6. Invader overlap vs bunker: any live cell inside an invader AABB is erased each step (the formation "eats" the shields). Bunkers are rebuilt every wave.
112	
113	### 1.6 UFO (mystery ship)
114	Appears every `rand(18, 28)` s while `alive ≥ 8` (classic rule), from a random side at 6.5 wu/s along `UFO_Y`, with a warbling synth loop and a scanning emissive beam.
115	Score — the original's easter egg is preserved: `shotsFired == 23 || (shotsFired − 23) % 15 == 0` ⇒ 300, else weighted pick 50 (40 %) / 100 (30 %) / 150 (20 %) / 300 (10 %).
116	
117	### 1.7 Scoring, combo, lives, waves
118	- Combo: kills within `COMBO_WINDOW = 1.0 s` chain; multiplier = 1 (chain < 3), 2 (3–5), 3 (6–8), 4 (≥ 9). Awarded = base · multiplier, shown as floating text `+60 ×2`.
119	- Extra life at 1500, then every 10 000 (max 6 lives).

content.text:
# STEP 3 complete — Space Invaders is built, played, and verified

**61 files** written: root config (3), `shared/` (30 modules + `glass.css`), `Space_Invaders/` (19 modules + `index.html` + `plan.md`), a browser-level smoke test, and a README. `vite build` transforms all 69 modules with no unresolved imports.

## What was verified, at the input boundary (Playwright driving a real Chromium)

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| Boot → TITLE, zero console errors/warnings across every run | ✅ |
| Keyboard play: `Enter` starts, held `←/→` + `Space` scores kills, `Esc` pause/resume | ✅ (e.g. 100 pts / 5 kills in 3.6 s of play) |
| Gamepad (injected standard pad): A confirms, stick + dead-zone, d-pad, RT fires, Start pauses, B resumes | ✅ |
| **Win path**: waves 1→5 → VICTORY, extra lives at 1 500 / 10 000 steps, endless option | ✅ (29 015 pts) |
| **Loss paths**: all cannons lost → GAME_OVER; invasion line breached → GAME_OVER("invaded") | ✅ both |
| Spread shot (3 bolts/press), shield absorb (no life lost), UFO kill (+150), formation eats bunkers (319→200 cells) | ✅ |
| Camera fit at 1920×1080 / 1280×720 / 1000×1000 / 800×1200 — all playfield extremes inside NDC ±0.9 | ✅ |
| Memory: 3 full game cycles leave `renderer.info.memory` identical (19 geo / 21 tex / 25 programs); `engine.dispose()` → 0 / 0, canvas + HUD removed | ✅ |

## Things I found by playing and fixed
- **Bloom washout** — the initial tuning clipped emitters to white; retuned twice, the second time because I discovered the original MSAA-composer path was silently *under*-blooming (post passes sampling multisampled buffers). Replaced with `SceneMSAAPass`: one resolve per frame instead of three → **50 → 68 fps** on this Intel iGPU, and bloom now follows the actual threshold math.
- **Sub-frame taps were lost** (Playwright's `press` exposed it): keyboard edges now come from a per-key keydown counter, so a tap shorter than a frame — or two taps in one frame — always registers.
- **PBR metals rendered black** (nothing to reflect): added a procedural PMREM neon environment (`shared/render/EnvironmentMap.js`).
- Spawn fairness: aimed-shot chance now scales by wave (18 % → 40 %) with a 1.6 s fire-grace after each respawn; the stationary-cannon deaths I saw early were legitimate but harsh.
- Cosmetic: sun moved to "set into the grid", fog dissolves the grid's far edge, victory banner no longer overlaps the results card, empty status panel hidden, cannon silhouette rebuilt (fins, taller turret, neon collar).

## Two additions beyond the plan's file list
`shared/render/EnvironmentMap.js` and `shared/render/SceneMSAAPass.js` — both recorded in `plan.md` §5.2 along with the input-hardening note. Everything else matches the approved plan.

**Run it:** `npm install && npm run dev` → `http://127.0.0.1:5173/Space_Invaders/` (append `?seed=N` for a reproducible run). `npm run test:smoke` replays the acceptance drive if `playwright` is installed.

One honest caveat: the audio path is exercised (context unlocks on the first key, no errors, synth graphs build and tear down) but I can't hear it from here — the mix levels are set by ear-in-code, not by ear.
